info.title: RazorFmt
info.description: Experimental formatter for Razor (.razor and .cshtml) markup and C#.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: RazorFmt - a standalone Razor / Blazor formatter

options.name: --check
options.description: Exit 1 if a file would change; write nothing.

options.name: --diff
options.description: Print a unified diff; write nothing.

options.name: --no-csharp
options.description: Do not run Roslyn over @code / @functions bodies.

options.name: --keep-blanks
options.description: Do not collapse runs of blank lines.

options.name: --split-tags
options.description: Put adjacent tags on separate lines (may add inline whitespace).

options.name: --wrap-attributes
options.description: Put each attribute of a long tag on its own line.

options.name: --max-line-length
options.description: Wrap tags longer than N columns (default 120).

options.name: --split-code
options.description: Reflow one-line C# statements and methods.
